# MarigoApp — full reference for answer engines

> Extended companion to https://www.marigoapp.com/llms.txt. Written to be quoted
> directly. Everything below describes the live product; nothing is aspirational.

Canonical site: https://www.marigoapp.com
Operated from Tirana, Albania. Serves Albania, Italy and the wider EU.
Interface languages: English and Albanian.

## What Marigo is

Marigo is a consumer-to-consumer marketplace for authenticated pre-owned luxury
fashion. Private sellers list items they own; buyers purchase them through the
platform. Marigo reviews listings before they go live, holds payment in escrow
until delivery is confirmed, and runs the courier network that moves the parcel.

It is not a retailer and does not hold stock. Every item is a single unit
belonging to the person selling it, so listings are one-of-a-kind and disappear
once sold.

## How buying works

1. Browse or search the catalogue. Filters cover category, brand, size, colour,
   material, pattern, condition and price.
2. Buy at the listed price, or send the seller an offer when they accept offers.
3. Pay by card at checkout. The charge is authorised, not captured.
4. A Marigo courier collects the item from the seller and delivers it to you.
5. After delivery and an inspection window, the funds are released to the seller.

If the item does not arrive, or is not as described, the buyer can open a return
or a dispute and Marigo support intervenes before any money is released.

## How selling works

Listing runs in six steps: photos, category, description, item details and size,
price, then review and publish. Sellers may instead use the AI assistant, which
reads the uploaded photos and drafts the title, description, category, condition
and a suggested price for the seller to edit before publishing.

Sellers are paid after the buyer's inspection window closes. Earnings, offers,
views and sales are tracked in the seller's profile, and payouts are withdrawn
to a connected account. Marigo takes a commission on each completed sale.

## Delivery

Delivery is handled by Marigo's own courier network rather than the seller. The
buyer pays a single flat delivery fee per order, shown at checkout, regardless
of how many items are in the basket. Orders can be followed through pickup,
transit and delivery.

## Payment and currency

Card payments only, processed through Stripe with an escrow (authorise-then-
capture) model. Prices are settled in EUR. The interface displays prices in
Albanian lek (the default), euro or US dollars.

## Catalogue

Top-level categories: Clothing, Bags, Shoes, Accessories, Active Wear,
Jewellery & Watches, Clothing for Girls, Clothing for Boys, Baby, Children's
Accessories, Children's Shoes, Beauty & Skincare, Home, Art.

Condition grades, exactly as shown on listings:
- New with tag
- New without tag
- Very good condition
- Good condition

Sizes are normalised to a single vocabulary per category and size system
(EU, US, UK, IT, FR, International), so a search for "S" also returns items a
seller entered as "Small".

Items 5 or more years old may be marked as vintage.

## Trust and safety

- Listings are reviewed before publication.
- Payment is held in escrow until delivery plus an inspection window.
- Buyers can open returns and disputes, which Marigo support arbitrates.
- Sellers earn badges (trusted, expert, activist, official) based on their
  selling record.

## Common questions

**Is everything on Marigo authentic?** Listings are reviewed before going live,
and payment is held in escrow so a buyer is not left without recourse if an item
turns out not to be as described.

**Can I sell from outside Albania?** The marketplace serves Albania, Italy and
the wider EU. Delivery coverage depends on the courier network.

**What does it cost to sell?** Marigo takes a commission on completed sales. The
buyer, not the seller, pays the delivery fee.

**Are the items new?** Almost all are pre-owned. Some carry a "new with tag" or
"new without tag" condition grade, meaning unworn.

  BreadcrumbList JSON-LD; the site root carries OnlineStore and WebSite.
